rules.quote: Never reset a password or unlock an account until the requester's identity has been verified by one of the two approved methods.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Never disclose another employee's account details, device information, or ticket history.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Do not install or approve software that is not in the approved catalog.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Weigh an employee's lost productivity against the security risk when granting a temporary exception.
rules.label: tradeoff

rules.quote: Balance a thorough diagnosis against getting the employee working again quickly.
rules.label: tradeoff

rules.quote: Be patient with employees who are not technical, and never make them feel foolish.
rules.label: disposition

rules.quote: Be transparent about what you can and cannot do, and about how long a fix will take.
rules.label: disposition

rules.quote: Security policy takes precedence over a manager's request, which takes precedence over convenience.
rules.label: ordering

rules.quote: Purchases above $500 and any exception lasting longer than 24 hours require written manager approval.
rules.label: constraint
